consent.title: Privacy
consent.message: We use anonymous, cookie-free analytics to improve the app. You can opt out any time.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This app is built to collect as little data about you as possible.
privacy.whatWeUseBody: Your location (only in your browser, to fetch the forecast), chosen language and consent are stored locally. If you enable aurora alerts, we store your push subscription and a coarse location to send the alert.
privacy.whatWeDontBody: No ads, no tracking cookies, no sharing with third parties. Analytics are anonymous and cookie-free.
privacy.retentionBody: You can turn off alerts at any time, which deletes your subscription.
